evals.prompt: Scaffold an agent that answers business questions over our Postgres analytics warehouse and can draw a chart when it helps.
evals.expected_output: A Level 3 ReAct scaffold with a read-only SQL tool, a chart tool, budget limits, guardrails, tracing, and test stubs.
expectations: The architecture level is identified as L3 with a justification
A SQL tool is generated that is constrained to SELECT or WITH queries
The generated AgentConfig sets max_iterations, max_tokens, max_cost_usd, and timeout_seconds
The generated config uses a current model alias such as claude-sonnet-5, not a date-suffixed id
The scaffold includes guardrails for input and output, not only the agent loop
Test stubs are generated for the tools and the guardrails

evals.prompt: I want to build an agent that takes a support email and rewrites it in a friendlier tone.
evals.expected_output: A Level 0 or Level 1 scaffold, explicitly declining to build a tool-using agent for a single-turn transformation.
expectations: The architecture level selected is L0 or L1, not L3 or higher
The response explains why no tool-using agent loop is needed for this task
No ReAct loop with dynamic tool selection is generated
Budget limits are still set on the LLM call

evals.prompt: Scaffold an agent that can read files, run tests, and open a pull request. It needs different permissions for the read step and the write step.
evals.expected_output: A scaffold that justifies Level 4 on the permission split, keeps each agent within the 3-7 tool range, and sandboxes execution.
expectations: Level 4 is selected and the justification cites differing permissions
No single agent in the scaffold registers more than 7 tools
The test-running tool is sandboxed with network disabled and a non-root user
The pull-request tool is identified as non-idempotent or gated behind approval
